mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_override (plan_version_id, material_id, week_start_date, system_quantity, manual_quantity, reason, operated_by) VALUES (#{planVersionId}, #{materialId}, #{weekStartDate}, #{systemQuantity}, #{manualQuantity}, #{reason}, #{operatedBy})
mapper.update: INSERT INTO plan_override (plan_version_id, material_id, week_start_date, system_quantity, manual_quantity, reason, operated_by) VALUES (#{planVersionId}, #{materialId}, #{weekStartDate}, #{systemQuantity}, #{manualQuantity}, #{reason}, #{operatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE manual_quantity = #{manualQuantity}, reason = #{reason}, operated_by = #{operatedBy}, operated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plan_override WHERE plan_version_id = #{planVersionId} AND material_id = #{materialId} AND week_start_date = #{weekStartDate}
SELECT * FROM plan_override WHERE plan_version_id = #{planVersionId} ORDER BY material_id, week_start_date
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM plan_override WHERE plan_version_id = #{planVersionId} AND material_id = #{materialId} AND week_start_date = #{weekStartDate}
